description: Brought the water, named the blot, asked about the year and a day, and kept off the lines.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Spoke from the stair, set broth as dinner, and did not come up.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Asleep on the Golding. No lines.
name: Gib

description: Named as having eaten and gone to his loom. Not in the room.
name: Gillis Verbeke

description: Refused to have the paper touched, said he was well, and left the half-line empty.
name: William Shakespeare
